intro: Grish Longrunner is a tauren scout and messenger stationed near the Great Lift, the vital mechanical crossing connecting the southern Barrens with the canyons of Thousand Needles. Serving the interests of the Horde along this bustling boundary, he keeps watch over travelers and coordinates military movement across the frontier.

p: Positioned right beside the towering machinery of the Great Lift, Grish Longrunner stands watch over one of central Kalimdor's most precarious border crossings. The platform elevator is a lifeline connecting the arid wastes of the southern Barrens to the windswept mesas of Thousand Needles below. Between roving quilboar packs and competing territorial threats, travel along this vertical boundary is dangerous, making scouts like Grish essential for keeping the Horde informed and summoning reinforcements where they are sorely needed.
